responsibility: Implements GCC’s timing infrastructure for performance reporting, including the global timer instance enabled by -ftime-report, host-specific collection of user/system/wall-clock times and GGC memory totals, stack-based and standalone timers, nested child accounting, optional named client items for libgccjit, and formatted reporting/validation of phase and pass timing summaries. It is the executable timing engine behind timevar IDs from timevar.def and RAII or procedural timing calls from timevar.h.
same_name_distinction: Implements the runtime timing engine declared in timevar.h, using the timevar IDs and names defined in timevar.def to collect host time/GGC data, manage timer stacks and client items, and print/validate timing reports.
